thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate (502/504) and connection timeouts on /v1/generate across eu-west-1 starting 2855019950. Error rate: p99 spikes to 12s, p95 to 2.8s. Affected: hosted API, ~8% of requests failing. Deploy detected: rollout 2026-03-15T12:30Z to canary -> prod (deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-15-1623).
June (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging in #incidents. I'm jumping in. Any initial RCA?
Alex K.: Seeing a sudden rise in upstream gateway 502s from runtime pool rpool-gpu-5. Logs show repeated "connection reset by peer" from model-proxy instances. Rolling window shows spike aligns with deploy at ~12:30Z.
Maria S.: Confirmed. KV-cache hit rate dropped sharply at same time (prefix cold-starts). Could be kernel change in deploy affecting connection keepalive behavior.
eng-runtime: I'm pulling canary logs now. There's a new env var change for PROXY_MAX_CONN=100 in this deploy. Previous value was 500. Trying to correlate.
infra-sre: Noted. Also seeing high connection_close metrics on LB side; backend health flaps on a subset of backends. Possible conn pool exhaustion.
June (oncall): If PROXY_MAX_CONN was lowered that's suspicious. Can we revert that flag on prod backends as a quick mitigation?
Alex K.: Quick check: curl to one affected backend returns 502 with "peer reset". Stack trace from model-proxy: "error while reading: connection reset by peer".
eng-runtime: Repeating locally with same env var reproduces faster connection churn. Looks like keepalive/timeouts misaligned causing upstreams to drop connections under load.
June (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) immediate rollback of deploy to previous stable. 2) if rollback takes time, increase PROXY_MAX_CONN to 1000 via runtime override for region eu-west-1. 3) add circuit breaker on upstreams to prevent cascading failures. Which is faster?
support-ops: Customers are reporting 502s; we have 14 active tickets opened in the last 20 minutes. Severity: P1 for some customers. Notify sales/CS.
Alex K.: Rollback started: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=42  # executing now
incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by Alex K. (cmd logged). Rollback status: in_progress.
eng-runtime: While rollback is in progress, I'm applying runtime override to bump PROXY_MAX_CONN to 1000 on pool rpool-gpu-5: 
```
rzctl runtime-config set rpool-gpu-5 PROXY_MAX_CONN=1000 --region eu-west-1
```
Applying...
infra-sre: LB now shows backend drain happening as rollback proceeds. Expect brief 5xx flaps during pod replacement.
June (oncall): Alex, confirm rollback status and ETA. Maria, monitor p95/p99. Support, tell customers we're rolling back and investigating, ETA ~15m.
Alex K.: Rollback completed at 2855020302. All inference-api pods on previous revision are up. Healthchecks passing.
eng-runtime: PROXY_MAX_CONN override applied successfully at 2855020315. Early metrics: 5xx rate falling from 8% -> 1.5% over last 2 minutes. p95 latency down to 350ms, p99 down to 1.2s.
Maria S.: KV-cache warmup in progress; hit rate climbing. Some backend instances still showing occasional 502s but much improved.
support-ops: Sent customer update thread: "We've identified a regression with a recent deploy causing intermittent 502s. We rolled back the change and errors are subsiding. We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes."
infra-sre: Noting that the failing change was a proactive connection-limiting config intended to protect memory, but it was set too low. We'll need a follow-up to test guardrails.
June (oncall): Good. Assigning follow-ups: ENG-RUNTIME to run canary with PROXY_MAX_CONN variants, add pre-deploy load test for conn limits. INFRA to add LB alert for backend_conn_close spikes. SUPPORT to consolidate customer impacts into INC-2026-4587.
Alex K.: Creating incident INC-2026-4587 and attaching timeline + logs. Adding postmortem template.
eng-runtime: Quick note: we had no autoscaler config change; this was purely env var. Add to rollout checklist: env var gating + small ramp with traffic shaping.
Maria S.: Customer impact estimate: ~8% requests 502 for 18 minutes, peak errors from 12:31Z-12:48Z, affected region eu-west-1 only. No data loss, just request failures.
support-ops: CS/AMs notified. Escalation handled, customers asked to retry.
June (oncall): Handoff: My shift ends in 30m. I'll do final check in 15m and hand to next oncall. If p99 stable < 2s for 10m, we can mark mitigating.
infra-sre: Adding note to incident channel: keep an eye on backend_conn_close and proxied_conn_errors dashboards.
Alex K.: Logs archived to s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-4587/2855019999.tar.gz
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem due in 72h. Assigning to eng-runtime + infra-sre.
June (oncall): Thanks team. Short summary for handoff: deploy caused PROXY_MAX_CONN=100 change, triggered conn exhaustion on model-proxy -> elevated 502s and p99 spikes. Rolled back deploy, applied temporary override, errors falling. Follow-ups assigned. Over to next oncall. :white_check_mark:
Maria S.: Acknowledged. I'll keep watching metrics for the next hour and will add graphs to the incident doc.
eng-runtime: Also adding a canary job to simulate sustained connections before next rollout.
support-ops: I'll keep customer comms open and escalate if any new reports come in.
June (oncall): Handoff complete at 2855021488.
